book.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
book.description:
Ever since Harry Potter had come home for the summer, the Dursleys had been so mean and hideous that all Harry wanted was to get back to the Hogwarts School for Witchcraft and Wizardry. But just as he’s packing his bags, Harry receives a warning from a strange impish creature who says that if Harry returns to Hogwarts, disaster will strike.
 
 And strike it does. For in Harry’s second year at Hogwarts, fresh torments and horrors arise, including an outrageously stuck-up new professor and a spirit who haunts the girls’ bathroom. But then the real trouble begins – someone is turning Hogwarts students to stone. Could it be Draco Malfoy, a more poisonous rival than ever? Could it possibly be Hagrid, whose mysterious past is finally told? Or could it be the one everyone at Hogwarts most suspects… Harry Potter himself!

book.title: Domination and the Arts of Resistance
book.description:
“A splendid study, surely one of the most important that has appeared on the whole matter of power and resistance.”—Natalie Zemon Davis
 
Confrontations between the powerless and powerful are laden with deception—the powerless feign deference and the powerful subtly assert their mastery. Peasants, serfs, untouchables, slaves, laborers, and prisoners are not free to speak their minds in the presence of power. These subordinate groups instead create a secret discourse that represents a critique of power spoken behind the backs of the dominant. At the same time, the powerful also develop a private dialogue about practices and goals of their rule that cannot be openly avowed.
 
In this book, renowned social scientist James C. Scott offers a penetrating discussion both of the public roles played by the powerful and powerless and the mocking, vengeful tone they display off stage—what he terms their public and hidden transcripts. Using examples from the literature, history, and politics of cultures around the world, Scott examines the many guises this interaction has taken throughout history and the tensions and contradictions it reflects.

book.title: The Stranger
book.description: Published in 1942 by French author Albert Camus,  The Stranger  has long been considered a classic of twentieth-century literature.  Le Monde  ranks it as number one on its "100 Books of the Century" list. Through this story of an ordinary man unwittingly drawn into a senseless murder on a sundrenched Algerian beach, Camus explores what he termed "the nakedness of man faced with the absurd."

localized_description.text: Published in 1942 by French author Albert Camus,  The Stranger  has long been considered a classic of twentieth-century literature.  Le Monde  ranks it as number one on its "100 Books of the Century" list. Through this story of an ordinary man unwittingly drawn into a senseless murder on a sundrenched Algerian beach, Camus explores what he termed "the nakedness of man faced with the absurd."

The Stranger is not merely one of the most widely read novels of the 20th century, but one of the books likely to outlive it. Written in 1946, Camus's compelling and troubling tale of a disaffected, apparently amoral young man has earned a durable popularity (and remains a staple of U.S. high school literature courses) in part because it reveals so vividly the anxieties of its time. Alienation, the fear of anonymity, spiritual doubt--all could have been given a purely modern inflection in the hands of a lesser talent than Camus, who won the Nobel Prize in 1957 and was noted for his existentialist aesthetic. The remarkable trick of The Stranger, however, is that it's not mired in period philosophy.
The plot is simple. A young Algerian, Meursault, afflicted with a sort of aimless inertia, becomes embroiled in the petty intrigues of a local pimp and, somewhat inexplicably, ends up killing a man. Once he's imprisoned and eventually brought to trial, his crime, it becomes apparent, is not so much the arguably defensible murder he has committed as it is his deficient character. The trial's proceedings are absurd, a parsing of incidental trivialities--that Meursault, for instance, seemed unmoved by his own mother's death and then attended a comic movie the evening after her funeral are two ostensibly damning facts--so that the eventual sentence the jury issues is both ridiculous and inevitable.
Meursault remains a cipher nearly to the story's end--dispassionate, clinical, disengaged from his own emotions. "She wanted to know if I loved her," he says of his girlfriend. "I answered the same way I had the last time, that it didn't mean anything but that I probably didn't." There's a latent ominousness in such observations, a sense that devotion is nothing more than self-delusion. It's undoubtedly true that Meursault exhibits an extreme of resignation; however, his confrontation with "the gentle indifference of the world" remains as compelling as it was when Camus first recounted it. --Ben Guterson
From Library Journal
The new translation of Camus's classic is a cultural event; the translation of Cocteau's diary is a literary event. Both translations are superb, but Ward's will affect a naturalized narrative, while Browner's will strengthen Cocteau's reemerging critical standing. Since 1946 untold thousands of American students have read a broadly interpretative, albeit beautifully crafted British Stranger . Such readers have closed Part I on "door of undoing" and Part II on "howls of execration." Now with the domestications pruned away from the text, students will be as close to the original as another language will allow: "door of unhappiness" and "cries of hate." Browner has no need to "write-over" another translation. With Cocteau's reputation chiefly as a cineaste until recently, he has been read in French or not at all. Further, the essay puts a translator under less pressure to normalize for readers' expectations. Both translations show the current trend to stay closer to the original. Marilyn Gaddis Rose, SUNY at Binghamton
Copyright 1988 Reed Business Information, Inc. --This text refers to the Hardcover edition.
Review
“The Stranger is a strikingly modern text and Matthew Ward’s translation will enable readers to appreciate why Camus’s stoical anti-hero and ­devious narrator remains one of the key expressions of a postwar Western malaise, and one of the cleverest exponents of a literature of ambiguity.” –from the Introduction by Peter Dunwoodie

book.title: Dune
book.description:
Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the “spice” melange, a drug capable of extending life and enhancing consciousness. Coveted across the known universe, melange is a prize worth killing for...
 
When House Atreides is betrayed, the destruction of Paul’s family will set the boy on a journey toward a destiny greater than he could ever have imagined. And as he evolves into the mysterious man known as Muad’Dib, he will bring to fruition humankind’s most ancient and unattainable dream.

book.title: Cunning Folk
book.description:
Money's tight and their new home is a fixer-upper. Deep in rural South West England, with an ancient wood at the foot of the garden, Tom and his family are miles from anywhere and anyone familiar. His wife, Fiona, was never convinced that buying the money-pit at auction was a good idea. Not least because the previous owner committed suicide. Though no one can explain why.
 
 Within days of crossing the threshold, when hostilities break out with the elderly couple next door, Tom's dreams of future contentment are threatened by an escalating tit-for-tat campaign of petty damage and disruption.
 
 Increasingly isolated and tormented, Tom risks losing his home, everyone dear to him and his mind. Because, surely, only the mad would suspect that the oddballs across the hedgerow command unearthly powers. A malicious magic even older than the eerie wood and the strange barrow therein. A hallowed realm from where, he suspects, his neighbours draw a hideous power.

book.title: Rosemary: The Hidden Kennedy Daughter
book.description:
They were the most prominent American family of the twentieth century. The daughter they secreted away made all the difference. 
 
 Joe and Rose Kennedy’s strikingly beautiful daughter Rosemary attended exclusive schools, was presented as a debutante to the Queen of England, and traveled the world with her high-spirited sisters. And yet, Rosemary was intellectually disabled — a secret fiercely guarded by her powerful and glamorous family.  Major new sources — Rose Kennedy’s diaries and correspondence, school and doctors' letters, and exclusive family interviews — bring Rosemary alive as a girl adored but left far behind by her competitive siblings. Kate Larson reveals both the sensitive care Rose and Joe gave to Rosemary and then — as the family’s standing reached an apex — the often desperate and duplicitous arrangements the Kennedys made to keep her away from home as she became increasingly intractable in her early twenties. Finally, Larson illuminates Joe’s decision to have Rosemary lobotomized at age twenty-three, and the family's complicity in keeping the secret. 
  
  Rosemary delivers a profoundly moving coda: JFK visited Rosemary for the first time while campaigning in the Midwest; she had been living isolated in a Wisconsin institution for nearly twenty years. Only then did the siblings understand what had happened to Rosemary and bring her home for loving family visits. It was a reckoning that inspired them to direct attention to the plight of the disabled, transforming the lives of millions.

book.title: Storm Front
book.description:
Harry Dresden--Wizard
Lost items found. Paranormal investigations.
Consulting. Advice. Reasonable rates.
No Love Potions, Endless Purses, Parties, or Other Entertainment.  Harry Dresden is the best at what he does. Well, technically, he's the only at what he does. So when the Chicago P.D. has a case that transcends mortal creativity or capability, they come to him for answers. For the "everyday" world is actually full of strange and magical things--and most of them don't play too well with humans. That's where Harry comes in. Takes a wizard to catch a--well, whatever.  There's just one problem. Business, to put it mildly, stinks. So when the police bring him in to consult on a grisly double murder committed with black magic, Harry's seeing dollar signs. But where there's magic, there's a black mage behind it. And now that mage knows Harry's name. And that's when things start to get... interesting.  Magic. It can get a guy killed.

book.title: Tao-Te Ching
book.description: O Tao-te Ching é um dos textos mais importantes e mais conhecidos da literatura chinesa, uma obra essencial para quem busca uma vivência espiritual no mundo contemporâneo, no entanto, ela nem sempre é de fácil compreensão. Assim, esta edição do Tao-Te Ching, comentada por Lúcia Helena Galvão, professora de filosofia da Nova Acrópole, chega para apresentar essas sabedorias de forma mais palatável, fruto de uma série de palestras que Lúcia realizou sobre o tema. Segundo ela, a ideia é que se penetre no Tao-Te Ching, desmistificando aquela imagem de "ininteligível" que o livro possui, podendo interpretá-lo e vivenciá-lo.

book.title: 50 Things to Know About Pet Isopods
book.description:
Are you looking for an exotic and unique pet that doesn’t require too much attention? Have you ever wanted a snack that both you and a pet amphibian or reptile can enjoy? Do you have a five liter plastic container?
 
If you answered yes to any of these questions then this book is for you.

50 Things to Know About Pet Isopods by author Dante Silva offers an approach on how to care for some of Mother Nature’s tiniest, but highly important little critters. Most people see a roly-poly or pill bug and tell you it's a dirty pest that contributes nothing to the environment. Those people are wrong. In these pages you'll discover the beauty of isopods.
 
By the time you finish this book, you will not only learn how to properly care for a roly-poly, but you’ll understand why these creatures are important parts of the world around them.

book.title: Wind, Sand and Stars
book.description:
在线阅读本书
In 1926 de Saint-Exupéry began flying for the pioneering airline Latécoère - later known as Aéropostale - opening up the first mail routes across the Sahara and the Andes. WIND, SAND AND STARS is drawn from this experience. Interweaving encounters with nomadic Arabs and other adventures into a richly textured autobiographical narrative which includes the extraordinary story of his crash in the Libyan Desert in 1936, and his miraculous survival. 'Self-discovery comes when a man measures himself against an obstacle,' writes Saint-Exupéry.  This book he explores the transcendent perceptions that arise when life is tested to its limits. Both a gripping tale of adventure and a poetic meditation.

book.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
book.description:
The apocalypse will be televised! Welcome to the first book in the wildly popular and addictive Dungeon Crawler Carl series by Matt Dinniman—now with bonus material exclusive to this print edition.
You know what’s worse than breaking up with your girlfriend? Being stuck with her prize-winning show cat. And you know what’s worse than that? An alien invasion, the destruction of all man-made structures on Earth, and the systematic exploitation of all the survivors for a sadistic intergalactic game show. That’s what.
Join Coast Guard vet Carl and his ex-girlfriend’s cat, Princess Donut, as they try to survive the end of the world—or just get to the next level—in a video game–like, trap-filled fantasy dungeon. A dungeon that’s actually the set of a reality television show with countless viewers across the galaxy. Exploding goblins. Magical potions. Deadly, drug-dealing llamas. This ain’t your ordinary game show.
Welcome, Crawler. Welcome to the Dungeon. Survival is optional. Keeping the viewers entertained is not.
Includes part one of the exclusive bonus story “Backstage at the Pineapple Cabaret.”

book.title: Incidents Around the House
book.description:
A chilling horror novel about a haunting told from the perspective of a young girl whose troubled family is targeted by an entity she calls “Other Mommy,” from the New York Times bestselling author of Bird Box

To eight-year-old Bela, her family is her world. There’s Mommy, Daddo, and Grandma Ruth. But there is also Other Mommy, a malevolent entity who asks her every day: “Can I go inside your heart?”

When horrifying incidents around the house signal that Other Mommy is growing tired of asking Bela the same question, over and over . . . Bela understands that unless she says yes, soon her family must pay.

Other Mommy is getting restless, stronger, bolder. Only the bonds of family can keep Bela safe but other incidents show cracks in her parents' marriage. The safety Bela relies on is on the brink of unraveling.

But Other Mommy needs an answer.

Incidents Around the House is a chilling, wholly unique tale of true horror told by the child Bela. A story about a family as haunted as their home.

book.title: Ode to the Half-Broken
book.description:
Forty years ago, the world nearly ended.
 
 Be is an old robot who was there, and doesn’t want to think about what happened, or what role they played in that conflict. They have settled into a life of isolation in the abandoned ruins of an old mill in the former New York Botanical Gardens, disinterested in what has happened in the outside world since they stepped away from the war. Someone out there, though, has not forgotten about them, and when they are attacked, their person vandalized, one of their legs stolen, they set out to find the thief accompanied by a cyborg dog and a human mechanic.
 
 The world has changed, but the recovery from the war is uneven and faltering, and Be begins to suspect a malicious hand trying to rekindle the old conflict and finish what was started. In order to stop them, Be needs to come to terms with both their own past and who they have become, and how everything and everyone else they knew has changed in their absence. Being left alone is no longer an option, and peace may be impossible.
 
 This is a story about coming to terms with your past, with who you’ve become and who you still want to be: a tale of resilence and hope, an ode to those struggling to become whole in a world half-broken.

book.title: Doubleblind
book.description:
It’s not easy to tread lightly wearing steel-toed boots.

Sirantha Jax isn’t known for diplomatic finesse. As a “Jumper” who navigates ships through grimspace, she’s used to kicking ass first and taking names later—much later. Not exactly the obvious choice to sell the Conglomerate to the Ithtorians, a people whose opinions of humans are as hard as their exoskeletons.

And Ithiss-Tor council meetings aren’t the only place where Ambassador Jax needs to maneuver carefully. Her lover, March, is frozen in permanent “kill” mode, and his hair-trigger threatens to sabotage the talks—not to mention their relationship.

But Jax won’t give up on the man or the mission. With the Outskirts beleaguered by raiders, pirates, and the flesh-eating Morgut, an alliance with Ithiss-Tor may be humanity’s only hope.

Which has Jax wondering why a notorious troublemaker like her was given the job.

collection.title: non-usamerican movies i liked
collection.brief:
(starting from september 16 2025. will be updating)

~ movies i gave 3.5 or more ⭐

i watch way too many usamerican movies (proportionally). particularly since recent developments there, i've been wanting to change that. 

note: i've included movies from all other countries besides the US, despite their particular history of human rights violations. that's because (1) i believe that, as of today, the US has the greatest capacity to influence foreign policy and thinking through its media and (2) this is mainly an attempt to reduce my cultural dependence on a single country and diversify my perspectives.

hopefully other folks might find something interesting to watch in this list too?

collection.title: [All] Neurodivergent
collection.brief:
A curated collection of live-action productions featuring neurodivergent stories and characters. This includes representations of Autism Spectrum, ADHD, OCD, Dyslexia, Dyspraxia, Dyscalculia, Down Syndrome, Hyperlexia, and more.

* Notes have been added for productions I’ve watched or where a character is explicitly confirmed as neurodivergent.
* For works I have yet to watch, inclusion is based on (1) descriptions and (2) reviews from various sources.


### On ND Coding

Interpretations of neurodivergent coding are subjective and assessed on a case-by-case basis.


### Exclusions (subjective)

1. Works where a neuroatypical character—confirmed or not—exists purely as a literary device or to serve the plot.
1. Cases where the author has explicitly denied neurodivergent coding, even if the character is widely perceived as such.

collection.title: 1990s High-Concept Action Films
collection.brief:
Started by [some comments](https://eggplant.place/@klu9@eggplant.place/posts/598223806114400144/) on [*Hard Rain*](https://eggplant.place/movie/0g2796rXqq1YyJFwK5vGUI) (1998).

### What is "high-concept"?
{Best droning school debate voice} Wikipedia defines "high-concept" as a type of artistic work that can be easily pitched with a succinctly stated premise.[1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_concept) 

- E.g. **"It's an armoured car heist but in the middle of a flood. I call it *Hard Rain*."**

Probably the classic high-concept action film pitch since 1988 is "It's *Die Hard* in a... / on a... / at a... / {prepositions ad nauseam} a ...".

- E.g. **"It's *Die Hard* at an airport. I call it *Die Hard 2*."**

I'll add films gradually, and if you're one of my mutuals here on eggplant.place, you can add films too!

collection.title: [TV] Remote Realms (favourite)
collection.brief:
Across channels and continents, in formats old and new, these are the broadcasts that linger.

From scripted tales to unscripted turns, late-night comforts to midday curiosities, each screenlit moment offered something that asked to be stayed with—perhaps for its rhythm, its chaos, its charm, or its quiet truth.

Here gather the series, shows, and streams that once tuned into something within—and never quite turned off.

collection.title: [Film] The Flicker Keep (favourite)
collection.brief:
### The Flicker Keep

A trove of tales sealed in celluloid dreams.  
These are not merely films watched,  
but companions met in the hush between frames—  

  - lantern-lit journeys through imagined cities,  
  - heartbeats synced to soundtracks,  
  - scenes etched into the architecture of feeling.

Woven into these reels are the visions that returned again and again,  
not just to be watched,  
but to be remembered.

collection.title: Animation as a Medium
collection.brief: This list curates a selection of animated movies and shows intended to show the breadth of animation as a medium. I've included some Western, some Asian, some mainstream, some indie, some for adults, some for entire families; basically, a bit of everything. The focus of this list isn't necessarily to assemble the best of the best — there's definitely some true classics I've left off the list — so much as to highlight all the different things animation can be: serious, silly, adult, juvinelle, speculative, literary, plot-driven, visuals-driven, and everything in between.

collection.title: the post-post-apocalyptic
collection.brief:
thinking about [this article](https://www.publicbooks.org/no-future-lexicon-the-post-post-apocalyptic/).

> “What cannot be mended must be transcended.” So wrote American author Ursula K. Le Guin in Tehanu (1990), a novel that begins with a deed of unspeakable trauma and ends with an act of literal transmutation. But what lies beyond the end of the world? Casting off the trappings accreted by the post-apocalyptic genre emerge stories of the post-post-apocalyptic. Embracing new tones and structures, the post-post-apocalyptic speaks after sufficient time has elapsed since collapse, where mere survival or disaster management is no longer the all-consuming priority. Recovery and healing of nature, culture, and individuals is occurring in earnest, as new systems, norms, and practices take root. In the post-post-apocalyptic, some severance exists to separate past calamity from present instance, making direct extrapolation from “then to now” neither instructive nor fruitful. While there may be traces from the previous world, the narrative emphasis lies not in harkening back, but rather embodying the contingencies of the present out of which the novel and unexpected can arise. Offering distance and difference in vantage, the post-post-apocalyptic allows the imaginary lens to recenter its focus on a freed moment in time, along with its sovereign, mutable future.

collection.brief:
## Movies from the #Monsterdon #WatchParty on Mastodon

Every Sunday 9pm US Eastern time ([see that in your local time](https://howlonghowmany.com/my-time/eastern-time/9-pm)), watch a monster/horror/sci-fi movie and join in the fun by posting on Mastodon with the `#Monsterdon` hashtag.

- #Monsterdon is hosted by @Taweret@timeloop.cafe
- [#Monsterdon links](https://eggplant.place/article/6rDmLDRFLehCVJhdOJrvXb) (wiki, Bingo cards, merch, replay etc)
- See [#MonsterdonDoubleFeature](https://eggplant.place/collection/6XljDxTgNHqpDrmP4Dxsl3) for another film after #Monsterdon (& a TV episode before).
- [More info on watch parties](https://joinfediverse.wiki/Watch_party)
- [Tips on avoiding ads during watch parties](https://ohai.social/@klu9/115245207831850566)
- Is #Monsterdon on too late for you? Or you missed previous events? Try [#ReMonsterdon](https://eggplant.place/collection/4fudrrfAyocAtkSv6ltlb6), a watch party ~6 hours earlier reshowing #Monsterdon films.

### Additional info in collection entries
Watch date
- Watch party announcement
- Miru stream announcement
- JustWatch legit stream search (default US, adjust for your country)
- Stream/s & download/s that work in Mexico & hopefully elsewhere too
- **S**=stream on demand, **SS**=scheduled stream, **D**=download, **BT**=BitTorrent. You can usually download **S** using a tool like [YtDownloader](https://ohai.social/@klu9/115400874929871716)

collection.title: #ReMonsterdon
collection.brief:
A [watch party](https://joinfediverse.wiki/Watch_party) on Sundays 7pm GMT/UTC (12pm US Pacific, 9pm Central Europe) that's a chance to have fun watching a monster / horror / scifi film that has already been shown in the [#Monsterdon](https://eggplant.place/collection/6ICD4rDFsYEIcTpY8UTpdk) (Sundays 6pm US Pacific) watch party on Mastodon, but at a time more convenient for people in Europe & Africa.

Join in the fun on Mastodon by pressing play at the appointed time & posting on Mastodon with the hashtag `#ReMonsterdon`

- [See 7pm GMT/UTC in your local time](https://time.unitarium.com/utc/7pm)
- #ReMonsterdon start times around the world: [(Northern Hemisphere DST version)](https://eggplant.place/article/0Ec8rgg2PO3Tq8GxkVthBE)

#### More info on watch parties
- [JoinFediverse.wiki - Watch party](https://joinfediverse.wiki/Watch_party)
- [Tips on avoiding ads during watch parties](https://ohai.social/@klu9/115245207831850566)

#### Future
You can nominate a film from among the many (175+) already shown in [#Monsterdon](https://eggplant.place/collection/6ICD4rDFsYEIcTpY8UTpdk). ([~25 available on PeerTube](https://tube.me.jon-e.net/video-channels/monsterdon).) Post your nomination with the hashtag #ReMonsterdon & every week I'll choose 4 for a #ReMonsterdonPoll you can vote in. And on the 1st Sunday of each month, we'll see a Godzilla film, in order as in the [Godzilla collection here](https://eggplant.place/collection/17rXMYOKPA0mRHZ0w2PiaW).

#### Info in entries
- Watch party number & date
- Watch party announcement
- JustWatch stream search (default US, adjust for your country)
- Streams (S) & downloads (D) that work in Mexico & maybe elsewhere too. (If you know others, send them to me & I'll add them.)

collection.title: [Anime] Drawn to Me (favourite)
collection.brief:
## Drawn to Me

Not merely watched — but felt.  
Not just drawn — but drawn *in*.

These stories didn’t end at the credits.  
They stayed — in the quiet, in the colour of thoughts,  
in moments when real life paused and something animated filled the space.

**What lives here:**

- Tales inked in motion and meaning.  
- Characters who kept walking beside me, long after.  
- Frames that flickered once, but somehow still glow.  
- Scenes that found a place between memory and mood.  
- Worlds that didn’t ask to be remembered — but were.

This is more than animation.  
It’s the part that chose to stay.

---

ℹ️ **アニメ** (**anime**) is simply the shortened form of **アニメーション** (**animeesyon**; **animēshon**; **animation**).

ℹ️ Only non-Japanese gives it a restrictive meaning as "Japanese-only animation".

ℹ️ **アニメ** (**anime**) is a Nihongo word, thus, it's respectful to use the _**correct**_ definition.

game.title: Calico
game.description:
Calico is a puzzly tile-laying game of quilts and cats.

In Calico, players compete to sew the coziest quilt as they collect and place patches of different colors and patterns. Each quilt has a particular pattern that must be followed, and players are also trying to create color and pattern combinations that are not only aesthetically pleasing, but also able to attract the cuddliest cats!

Turns are simple. Select a single patch tile from your hand and sew it into your quilt, then draw another patch into your hand from the three available. If you are able to create a color group, you may sew a button onto your quilt. If you are able to create a pattern combination that is attractive to any of the cats, it will come over and curl up on your quilt! At the end of the game, you score points for buttons, cats, and how well you were able to complete your unique quilt pattern.

—description from the publisher

game.title: Kapibarista
game.description:
Everyone in town is looking for a cozy little café where they can relax with a good book, something to nibble on, and, of course, some delicious caffeinated beverages. As a capybara with a love for coffee, it’s always been a dream of yours to open your own shop. Now is the perfect time! But you’re not the only one opening your doors in hopes of enticing customers. Rival coffee shops are popping up all over town and it’s up to you to ensure that you have the right food, drinks, and decor to turn your drop-ins into regulars. Put together a delicious menu and decorate your shop to capture the perfect aesthetic. You just might have the busiest little café in town!

Each turn, you play a card from your hand, either buying it as a food, drink, or decor item for your café or serving the customer on the card and earning money. If you meet a customer’s needs completely, they become a Regular and earn you extra end game points!

Café Baras is a card drafting, tableau-building game brought to you by the creative team behind the critter classics Creature Comforts and Maple Valley.

—description from the publisher

game.title: ASTRONEER
game.description:
Astroneers undergo rigorous training to explore the frontiers of outer space for the good of all humankind. Creativity and ingenuity are key to their survival!
  
   RESHAPE THE ENVIRONMENT         
  Astroneers are trained to use the Terrain Tool, a powerful instrument which can dig, collect, shape, build, and color terrain in any way they wish.
  
   GO HANDS-ON WITH BASEBUILDING         
  Build custom bases throughout the solar system to survive and thrive anywhere! Objects are snapped into place in a modular system that allows Astroneers to create unique builds. Automation systems, crafting stations, power plants, resource harvesters, and railway facilities are built from the ground up and can be customized to suit any situation.

   LEARN TO SURVIVE A STRANGE SOLAR SYSTEM         
  This unrecognized system consists of seven celestial bodies. Each of them can be explored entirely, from the rounded surface all the way down into the core. Astroneers will have to grapple with their unique geography and challenging biomes if they seek to understand them.
  
   UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF THE UNIVERSE         
  These strange worlds are dotted with mysterious structures and artifacts, while Astroneers themselves receive confusing comms from unknown sources. Curious Astroneers may seek to understand these anomalies, and with them, the secrets of the solar system.
  
   ALONE OR TOGETHER         
  While they're perfectly capable on their own, Astroneers are team players who are always happy to offer a helping hand! Group up with other Astroneers and work together in 2-4 player online co-op. Playing solo online allows fellow Astroneers to drop in and out of your world at their leisure.
   
WHERE WE ARE   
Astroneer began as an Early Access title on Steam in 2016, and reached 1.0 in 2019. We wouldn't be here today if not for our community's support, feedback, and ideation. As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

WHERE WE ARE

As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

Los Astroneers se someten a un riguroso entrenamiento para explorar las fronteras del espacio exterior por el bien de la humanidad. ¡La creatividad y el ingenio son la clave de su supervivencia!
 
   REMODELA EL ENTORNO         
  Los Astroneers han aprendido a usar la herramienta de terreno, un poderoso instrumento que les permite cavar, recoger, moldear, construir y colorear el terreno como deseen.
 
   CONSTRUYE BASES DE FORMA ACTIVA         
  Construye bases personalizadas por todo el sistema solar para poder sobrevivir y prosperar en cualquier lugar. Los objetos encajan unos con otros mediante un sistema modular que permite a los Astroneers crear construcciones únicas. Los sistemas de automatización, las estaciones de fabricación, las centrales energéticas, las cosechadoras de recursos y las instalaciones ferroviarias se construyen de cero y se pueden personalizar para adaptarse a cualquier situación.
   
   APRENDE A SOBREVIVIR EN UN SISTEMA SOLAR EXTRAÑO         
  Este sistema no reconocido contiene siete cuerpos celestes; cada uno de ellos se puede explorar por completo, desde la superficie esférica hasta el núcleo. Los Astroneers tendrán que lidiar con su geografía única y los desafiantes biomas si quieren llegar a comprenderlos. 
  
   DESCUBRE LOS MISTERIOS DEL UNIVERSO         
  En estos mundos tan extraños se pueden encontrar estructuras y artefactos misteriosos, y los Astroneers reciben mensajes confusos de fuentes desconocidas. Los más curiosos intentarán comprender estas anomalías y, a la vez, descubrir los secretos del sistema solar.
   
   A SOLAS O EN COMPAÑÍA         
  Aunque los Astroneers son perfectamente capaces de apañárselas sin ayuda, les gusta colaborar con otros y siempre están más que dispuestos a echarse una mano. Forma equipo con otros Astroneers y colaborad en el modo cooperativo en línea para 2-4 jugadores. Si juegas a solas en línea, otros Astroneers podrán entrar y salir de tu mundo a su antojo.
   
   DÓNDE ESTAMOS   
Astroneer empezó como un título de acceso anticipado en Steam en 2016, y la versión 1.0 se publicó en 2019. No estaríamos aquí hoy si no fuera por el apoyo, los comentarios y las sugerencias de nuestra comunidad. A medida que proseguimos nuestra aventura, queremos reiterar que estamos comprometidos a seguir ampliando de forma continua la base que es Astroneer con actualizaciones de contenido gratuitas.

Les Astroneers suivent un entraînement rigoureux afin d'explorer les frontières de l'espace pour le bien de l'humanité. La créativité et l'ingéniosité sont les clés de leur survie !  
  
   REMODELEZ L'ENVIRONNEMENT         
  Les Astroneers sont formés à l'utilisation de l'outil Terrain, un puissant instrument qui leur permet de creuser, récolter, façonner, construire et colorer le terrain à leur guise.
   
   CONSTRUISEZ DES BASES SUR MESURE         
  Construisez des bases personnalisées dans tout le système solaire pour survivre et prospérer ! Le système modulaire permet des créations uniques. Les systèmes d'automatisation, les stations d'artisanat, les centrales électriques, les collecteurs de ressources et les installations ferroviaires sont construits à partir de zéro et peuvent être personnalisés pour s'adapter à n'importe quelle situation.
   
   APPRENEZ À SURVIVRE DANS UN SYSTÈME SOLAIRE ÉTRANGE         
  Ce système méconnu est composé de sept corps célestes, chacun pouvant être exploré de la surface jusqu'au noyau. Les Astroneers devront se confronter à leur géographie unique et à leurs biomes complexes pour espérer les comprendre.
    
   DÉCOUVREZ LES MYSTÈRES DE L'UNIVERS         
  Ces mondes étranges sont parsemés de structures et d'artefacts mystérieux, tandis que les Astroneers eux-mêmes reçoivent des communications déroutantes de sources inconnues. Les plus curieux pourront chercher à comprendre ces anomalies afin de percer les secrets du système solaire.
   
   SEULS OU ENSEMBLE         
  Bien qu'ils soient parfaitement capables d'agir seuls, les Astroneers ont l'esprit d'équipe et sont toujours prêts à donner un coup de main ! Rejoignez jusqu'à 3 Astroneers et coopérez en ligne. Le mode solo en ligne permet aux autres Astroneers d'entrer et de sortir de votre monde à leur guise.
   
   ÉVOLUTION   
Astroneer a commencé en tant que titre en Early Access sur Steam en 2016, et a lancé sa version 1.0 en 2019. Nous ne serions pas là aujourd'hui sans le soutien, les commentaires et les idées de notre communauté. Pour la suite de notre voyage, nous voulons réitérer notre promesse de continuer à développer Astroneer avec des mises à jour de contenu gratuites et régulières.

Astroneers durchlaufen ein umfangreiches Training, um den Rand des Weltraums zum Wohle der Menschheit erkunden zu können. Kreativität und Einfallsreichtum sind der Schlüssel zu ihrem Überleben!
   
   GESTALTE DIE UMGEBUNG         
  Die Astroneers sind in der Nutzung des Terrain-Tools ausgebildet, eines mächtigen Instruments, mit dem sie nach Belieben graben, einsammeln, formen, errichten und einfärben können.
    
   BASISBAU AUS ERSTER HAND         
  Errichte eigene Basen im Sonnensystem, um überall zu überleben und aufzublühen! Objekte rasten dank eines modularen Systems an Ort und Stelle ein, wodurch die Astroneers einzigartige Bauwerke errichten können. Automatisierungssysteme, Herstellungsstationen, Kraftwerke, Ressourcenabbauer und Bahnanlagen können von Grund auf errichtet und an jede Situation angepasst werden.
   
   LERNE, IN EINEM FREMDEN SONNENSYSTEM ZU ÜBERLEBEN         
  Dieses unbekannte System besteht aus sieben Himmelskörpern, die alle von der Oberfläche bis zum Kern erkundet werden können. Die Astroneers werden sich mit ihrer einzigartigen Geografie und den herausfordernden Biomen auseinandersetzen müssen, wenn sie sie verstehen wollen.
  
    LÜFTE DIE GEHEIMNISSE DES UNIVERSUMS         
  Auf diesen fremden Welten gibt es geheimnisvolle Strukturen und Artefakte, während die Astroneers seltsame Nachrichten von unbekannten Quellen erhalten. Neugierige Astroneers können versuchen, mehr über diese Anomalien zu erfahren und die Geheimnisse des Sonnensystems zu lüften.
   
   ALLEINE ODER ZUSAMMEN         
  Obwohl die Astroneers auch alleine gut zurechtkommen, sind sie auch immer froh, anderen zur Hand gehen zu können! Schließe dich mit anderen Astroneers zusammen und spiele im Online-Koop-Modus mit Gruppen aus 2–4 Spielern. Und wenn du alleine online spielst, können andere Astroneers nach Belieben zu dir stoßen.
   
   WO WIR STEHEN   
Astroneer begann im Jahr 2016 als Early-Access-Spiel auf Steam und erreichte im Jahr 2019 Version 1.0. Ohne die Unterstützung und das Feedback der Community wären wir heute nicht hier. Während wir unsere Reise fortsetzen, möchten wir noch einmal bekräftigen, dass wir weiterhin mit kostenlosen Inhalts-Updates auf dem Fundament von Astroneer aufbauen wollen.

Os Astroneers são submetidos a treinos rigorosos para explorar os confins do espaço para o bem de toda a humanidade. A criatividade e a engenhosidade são fundamentais para a sobrevivência!
  
   REFORMULA O AMBIENTE         
  Os Astroneers são treinados para usar a Terrain Tool, uma poderosa ferramenta que te permite escavar, recolher, moldar, construir e colorir terreno como desejares.
  
   PÕE MÃOS À OBRA E CONSTRÓI UMA BASE         
  Cria bases personalizadas pelo sistema solar fora para sobreviver e prosperar onde quer que seja! Os objetos são ajustados ao seu lugar através de um sistema modular que permite aos Astroneers elaborar construções únicas. Sistemas de automação, estações de fabrico, centrais elétricas, coletores de recursos e estações ferroviárias são construídos de raiz e podem ser modificados para se adaptarem a qualquer situação.
   
APRENDE A SOBREVIVER A UM ESTRANHO SISTEMA SOLAR         
  Este sistema desconhecido consiste em sete corpos celestiais. Cada um pode ser explorado na íntegra, desde a sua superfície redonda até ao seu núcleo. Os Astroneers terão de enfrentar a sua geografia única e biomas desafiantes se os quiserem compreender.
  
   DESVENDA OS MISTÉRIOS DO UNIVERSO         
  Estes mundos estranhos incluem estruturas e artefactos misteriosos, e os próprios Astroneers recebem comunicações confusas de origens desconhecidas. Os Astroneers curiosos poderão procurar compreender estas anomalias e, com elas, os segredos do sistema solar.
  
   SOZINHO OU ACOMPANHADO         
  Embora sejam perfeitamente capazes sozinhos, os Astroneers são jogadores de equipa e ficam sempre felizes por oferecer uma mão amiga! Forma um grupo com outros Astroneers e trabalha numa equipa de 2–4 jogadores em cooperação online. Jogar a solo online permite aos Astroneers entrar e sair do seu mundo a seu bel-prazer.
  
 ONDE ESTAMOS   
Astroneer começou como um jogo de acesso antecipado no Steam em 2016 e chegou à versão 1.0 em 2019. Não estaríamos aqui hoje sem o apoio, os comentários e as ideias da nossa comunidade. Com o avançar da nossa viagem, queremos reiterar o nosso compromisso em continuar a construir os alicerces de Astroneer com atualizações de conteúdo grátis e contínuas.

Enhver Astroneer er omhyggeligt trænet til at udforske det ydre rums vilde vidder for menneskehedens bedste. Kreativitet og opfindsomhed er nøglen til at overleve!  
  
   OMFORM OMGIVELSERNE         
  En Astroneer er trænet til at bruge sit terrænværktøj, et mægtigt instrument, der kan grave, samle, forme, bygge og farve terræn efter forgodtbefindende.
   
   FÅ FINGRE I BASEBYGGERIET         
  Byg dine egne baser rundt omkring i solsystemet, så du kan overleve og trives overalt! Objekter bliver klikket på plads i et modulsystem, der lader en Astroneer skaber unikt byggeri. Automatiske systemer, håndværksstationer, kraftværker, ressourcehøstere og togfaciliteter bygges fra grunden og kan tilpasses enhver situation.
   
   LÆR AT OVERLEVE ET FORUNDERLIGT SOLSYSTEM         
  Dette ukendte system består af syv himmellegemer. Hver af dem kan udforskes frit fra den runde overflade helt ind til kernen. Som Astroneer må man kæmpe med deres unikke geografi og udfordrende biosfærer, hvis man vil forstå dem.
   
   AFDÆK UNIVERSETS MYSTERIER         
  Disse forunderlige verdener er overstrøet med mystiske bygninger og artefakter, og en Astroneer modtager forvirrende beskeder fra ukendte afsendere. En nysgerrig Astroneer kan forsøge at forstå disse uregelmæssigheder og dermed solsystemets hemmeligheder.
   
   ALENE ELLER SAMMEN         
  Selvom enhver Astroneer kan klare sig selv, så er de også holdspillere, der altid er klar til at give en hjælpende hånd! Slå dig sammen med andre i grupper på 2-4 spillere i online samarbejde. Hvis du spiller alene online, kan andre når som helst besøge og forlade din verden. 
  
   HVOR ER VI  
Astroneer startede i tidlig adgang på Steam i 2016 og nåede 1.0 i 2019. Vi ville ikke være her i dag, hvis det ikke var for vores spilleres støtte, kommentarer og idéer. Mens vi fortsætter vores rejse, vil vi gerne gentage vores løfte om fortsat at bygge videre på Astroneers fundament med gratis, fortsatte indholdsopdateringer.

Gli Astroneer vengono rigorosamente addestrati a esplorare le frontiere dello spazio cosmico per il bene di tutta l'umanità. La creatività e l'ingegno sono la chiave per la sopravvivenza!
   
   RIMODELLA L'AMBIENTE         
  Gli Astroneer sono addestrati a usare lo Strumento di terreno, un potente attrezzo per scavare, raccogliere, modellare, costruire e colorare il terreno in qualunque modo vogliano.
   
   CREA LA TUA PROPRIA BASE         
  Costruisci basi personalizzate in tutto il sistema solare per sopravvivere e prosperare ovunque! Gli oggetti si incastrano in un sistema modulare che consente agli Astroneer di creare strutture uniche. I sistemi di automatizzazione, le stazioni di creazione, le centrali energetiche, i raccoglitori di risorse e le strutture ferroviarie possono essere costruiti da zero e personalizzati in base alla situazione.
   
   IMPARA A SOPRAVVIVERE A UNO STRANO SISTEMA SOLARE         
  Questo sistema sconosciuto è costituito da sette corpi celesti completamente esplorabili, dalla superficie arrotondata fino al nucleo. Gli Astroneer dovranno affrontare la geografia unica e i biomi ostili di ogni pianeta per comprenderli appieno.
    
   SVELA I MISTERI DELL'UNIVERSO         
  Questi strani mondi sono disseminati di misteriose strutture e manufatti, mentre gli Astroneer captano comunicazioni confuse da fonti sconosciute. I più curiosi potrebbero voler comprendere queste anomalie, svelando al contempo i misteri del sistema solare.
   
   DA SOLI O INSIEME         
  Anche se sanno cavarsela da soli, gli Astroneer fanno gioco di squadra e sono sempre lieti di offrire il loro aiuto! Unisciti ad altri Astroneer e collabora con loro in sessioni online cooperative da 2 a 4 giocatori. Giocare da soli online consentirà ad altri fidati Astroneer di visitare e lasciare il tuo mondo a loro piacimento.
   
   IL NOSTRO VIAGGIO   Astroneer è nato nel 2016 come gioco ad accesso anticipato su Steam e ha raggiunto la versione 1.0 nel 2019. Non ce l'avremmo mai fatta senza il sostegno, il feedback e le idee della community. Mentre proseguiamo questo viaggio, vogliamo ribadire il nostro continuo impegno a costruire sulla base di Astroneer con costanti aggiornamenti gratuiti dei contenuti.

异星探险家接受着严格的训练，为全人类的利益探索外太空的边境。创造力与独创性是他们生存的关键！
  
  
   重塑环境         
  异星探险家接受过使用地形工具的训练，这种强大的工具可以按照使用者的意愿挖掘、收集、塑形及构建地形，并为其着色。
  
  
   亲手建造基地         
  在整个太阳系中建造定制的基地，以便在任何地方生存与发展！异星探险家通过模块化系统，可将物体快速拼接到位，创造出独特的建筑。自动化系统、制作站、发电厂、资源采集器、铁路设施，一切都是从零开始建造。并且可根据实际情况进行定制。
  
  
   学会在陌生的太阳系中生存         
  这个未知的星系由七个天体所组成。每个天体从地表一直到地心，都可以进行完整的探索。而想要了解它们，异星探险家就必须与其独特的地理环境及充满挑战的生物群落作斗争。
  
  
   揭开宇宙神秘的面纱         
  这些奇异的世界遍布着神秘的建筑和遗物，而异星探险家本身也会收到不明来源发来的让人百思不得其解的通讯。好奇的异星探险家或许会试图了解这些异象，以及太阳系的秘密。
  
  
   独自一人或与好友一起         
  虽然异星探险家各个独当一面，但他们也是乐于助人的团队合作者！与其他异星探险家组队，在2-4人在线合作模式中通力协作。单人游玩在线模式可允许其他异星探险家随意进出你的世界。
  
  
   我们的定位   《Astroneer》在2016年在Steam上架了抢先体验版，并于2019年推出1.0版本。而我们今天的成功也少不了社区的支持、反馈与意见。随着旅程的持续推进，我们将信守诺言，以《Astroneer》为基础，持续发布免费的内容更新。

Astroneerたちは全人類のために宇宙の辺境を探索する厳しい訓練を受けます。サバイバルの鍵となるのは創造力と発想力です！
  
  
   環境を作り変えよう         
  AstroneerたちはTerrain Toolを使用する訓練を受けています。これは地形をあなたの望みどおりに掘ったり、集めたり、形作ったり、構築したり、色を付けることができる強力なツールです。
  
  
   基地構築を実践しよう         
  場所を問わずに生き延びて繫栄できるように、星系中にカスタマイズした基地を建設しましょう！ オブジェクトはモジュラーシステムで所定の位置にスナップされるので、ユニークなビルドが可能になります。自動化システム、クラフトステーション、動力プラント、リソース収集機、鉄道施設をゼロから造り上げ、さまざまな状況に合わせてカスタマイズできます。
  
  
   見知らぬ星系でのサバイバルを学ぼう         
  この未確認の星系は7つの天体で構成されています。その丸い地表から核まで、それぞれの天体を隅々まで探索することが可能です。Astroneerたちはそのユニークな地形や困難なバイオームに立ち向かい、それを理解する必要があります。
  
  
   宇宙のミステリーを解き明かそう         
  これらの見知らぬ世界には謎めいた建造物やアーティファクトが点在しており、Astroneerたちも未知の発信源から不思議な通信を受信します。好奇心あふれるAstroneerたちは、これらの異常現象を調査し、星系の秘密を解き明かすことが可能です。
  
  
   ソロで、または一緒に冒険         
  Astroneerたちは独りでも任務を成し遂げられますが、彼らはチームプレイヤーでもあり、いつでも喜んで手助けしてくれます！ 2～4人のオンライン協力プレイで他のAstroneerたちとグループを組みましょう。ソロでもオンラインでプレイすれば、他のAstroneerたちが自由にあなたの世界に出入り可能になります。
  
  
   現在の開発状況   Astroneerは2016年にSteamで早期アクセスタイトルとしてスタートし、2019年に1.0に到達しました。コミュニティーからのサポートやフィードバック、アイデアの提案がなければ、ここまで来ることは不可能でした。この旅を続けるなかで、今後も基礎の上に構築を続けて、Astroneerに無料のコンテンツアップデートを提供し続けるという誓いを新たにします。

game.brief:
Astroneers undergo rigorous training to explore the frontiers of outer space for the good of all humankind. Creativity and ingenuity are key to their survival!
  
   RESHAPE THE ENVIRONMENT         
  Astroneers are trained to use the Terrain Tool, a powerful instrument which can dig, collect, shape, build, and color terrain in any way they wish.
  
   GO HANDS-ON WITH BASEBUILDING         
  Build custom bases throughout the solar system to survive and thrive anywhere! Objects are snapped into place in a modular system that allows Astroneers to create unique builds. Automation systems, crafting stations, power plants, resource harvesters, and railway facilities are built from the ground up and can be customized to suit any situation.

   LEARN TO SURVIVE A STRANGE SOLAR SYSTEM         
  This unrecognized system consists of seven celestial bodies. Each of them can be explored entirely, from the rounded surface all the way down into the core. Astroneers will have to grapple with their unique geography and challenging biomes if they seek to understand them.
  
   UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF THE UNIVERSE         
  These strange worlds are dotted with mysterious structures and artifacts, while Astroneers themselves receive confusing comms from unknown sources. Curious Astroneers may seek to understand these anomalies, and with them, the secrets of the solar system.
  
   ALONE OR TOGETHER         
  While they're perfectly capable on their own, Astroneers are team players who are always happy to offer a helping hand! Group up with other Astroneers and work together in 2-4 player online co-op. Playing solo online allows fellow Astroneers to drop in and out of your world at their leisure.
   
WHERE WE ARE   
Astroneer began as an Early Access title on Steam in 2016, and reached 1.0 in 2019. We wouldn't be here today if not for our community's support, feedback, and ideation. As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

game.title: Kusarihime: Euthanasia
game.description:
After the mysterious death of his father and his younger sister Juri, Itsuki, now suffering from amnesia, moves back to his hometown with his stepmother. There he meets an enigmatic young girl dressed in a crimson red kimono named Kurame, and the two soon become friends. The strange thing is, Kurame looks exactly like his younger sister Juri...

On the surface, Itsuki's family and friends all appear to be rooting for his full recovery. However, deep inside, they also seem to be burdened with secrets and guilt about the past. In the span of four days, Itsuki's memories will slowly return as he struggles between his loss and his fear of the truth, until the fourth night, when the whole world becomes blanketed under a red sheet of snow and wrapped up in the silence of death....

game.title: Mass Effect: Legendary Edition
game.description:
One person is all that stands between humanity and the greatest threat it’s ever faced. Relive the legend of Commander Shepard in the highly acclaimed Mass Effect trilogy with the Mass Effect Legendary Edition. Includes single-player base content and over 40 DLC from Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, and Mass Effect 3 games, including promo weapons, armors and packs — remastered and optimized for 4K Ultra HD.
 
 Experience an amazingly rich and detailed universe where your decisions have profound consequences on the action and the outcome.  

Relive the Cinematic Saga    
Heart-pounding action meets gripping interactive storytelling, where you decide how your unique story unfolds.  

   Three Games, One Launcher: Play through the single-player base content and over 40 DLC from all three games, including promo weapons, armors, and packs.

   Remastered for a New Generation: Experience the trilogy in 4K Ultra HD with enhanced performance, visuals, and graphics, all available in HDR.

   Visual Improvements on All 3 Games: Updates include enhanced models, shaders, FX, lighting and depth of field, plus full-resolution audio.    Experience the Legend of Shepard   Create and customize your own character — from appearance and skills to a personalized arsenal — then lead your elite recon squad across a galaxy in turmoil. 

   New Shepard Customizations: With improved hair, makeup, eye color and skin tones you can create your Shepard in a unified character creator with all options available across the full trilogy, or choose to play as the iconic Femshep from Mass Effect 3 now available in all titles.

   Gameplay Enhancements for the First Mass Effect Game: Enjoy improved aiming and weapons balance, SFX, better Mako controls, input/controls, squad behavior, cover behavior and gameplay cameras.    Reflect on Your Choices   Your choices seamlessly travel from one game to the next. Each decision you make will control the outcome of every mission, every relationship, every battle — and even the fate of the galaxy itself. 

   Visual Enhancements for the First Mass Effect Game: The game's been given a full world-building pass including environmental art, VFX and level relighting.

   PC Updates: Enjoy a modernized PC experience across all three games with native controller and 21:9 widescreen support, user interface navigation improvements, and DirectX 11 compatibility.      

Included Content    

Mass Effect Legendary Edition includes single-player base content for all 3 titles (Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2 and Mass Effect 3), your favorite single-player story DLC, promo weapons, armors and packs: 

   DLC: Bring Down the Sky, Genesis, Zaeed — The Price of Revenge, Kasumi — Stolen Memory, Lair of the Shadow Broker, Firewalker Pack, Overlord, Normandy Crash Site, Arrival, Genesis 2, From Ashes, Mass Effect 3: Extended Cut, Leviathan, Omega and Citadel.

   Weapons and Armor: Cerberus Weapons and Armor, Arc Projector, Collector's Weapon and Armor, Terminus Weapon and Armor, M-21 Incisor, Blood Dragon Armor, Inferno Armor, Recon Hood, Sentry Interface, Umbra Visor, N7 Warfare Gear, AT-12 Raider, Chakram Launcher, M-55 Argus, M-90 Indra and Reckoner Knight Armor.

   Packs: Equalizer Pack, Aegis Pack, Firepower Pack, Groundside Resistance Pack, Recon Operations Pack, Firefight Pack, ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 1, ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 2, ME3 Alternate Appearance Pack 1, and N7 Collector's Edition Pack.

localized_description.text:
有一个人，坚定地矗立在人类与其所面临的最大威胁之间，成为了那唯一的坚实壁垒。在《质量效应》传奇版中重温广受好评的《质量效应》三部曲，踏上薛帕德指挥官的精彩冒险之旅。《质量效应》传奇版将包含《质量效应》《质量效应 2》及《质量效应 3》单人基础游戏及超过 40 款 DLC，更有多种促销武器、装甲，及各种组合包等你来拿——精彩内容，重置优化新升级，4k Ultra HD，等你体验。
 
 
 在这个内容详实，细节丰富的广阔宇宙内探索发现，你的决定将对游戏行动及发展结果产生深远影响。  重现电影般的传奇  惊心动魄的冒险行动交织扣人心弦的互动故事，你将决定如何展开属于你的独特故事。
   三部游戏——统一启动器：畅玩《质量效应》三部曲单人基础游戏及超过 40 款 DLC，更有多种促销武器、装甲，及各种组合包等你来拿。
   新世代重置优化：借助增强纹理、视效和建模，在 4K Ultra HD 下重温经典三部曲，全部支持 HDR。
   全三部曲视效提升：游戏更新包括强化模型、着色器、FX、照明和景深以及全解析音频。  体验薛帕德传奇冒险  创建并自定义你的角色，从薛帕德指挥官的外表和技能，到个性化武器库，全都由你定义。随后，带领你的精英侦察队开启征程，穿越动荡的银河系。
   新式薛帕德自定义系统：借助改进的发型、化妆、眼睛颜色和皮肤色调，你可在三部曲中通过统一角色创建器中创建你自己的薛帕德，体验所有选项。或选择现已在所有游戏中都可使用的《质量效应 3》标志性女性薛帕德。
   初代《质量效应》玩法增强：享受精心改良的射击瞄准和武器平衡、灰鲭鲨号更佳操控、输入/控制、小队行为、掩护行为及游戏镜头设置。  斟酌您的选择  你的抉择将无缝贯穿游戏三部曲。你所做出的每一个决定都将影响每次任务、每段关系，及每场战斗的结果，甚至也会影响《质量效应》三部曲中整个银河系的命运。
   初代《质量效应》视觉增强：为你打造初代作品完整的世界构建，包括环境艺术、视觉特效和关卡重新布光。

銀河史上最大の脅威から人類を救える者はただ一人。「Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition」で名作「Mass Effect」三部作が蘇る。シェパード少佐の伝説を新たな環境で体験せよ。「Mass Effect」、「Mass Effect 2」、「Mass Effect 3」のシングルプレイヤーゲーム本編と、40 以上の DLC、プロモーション武器、アーマー、パックを収録。そのすべてを 4K ウルトラ HD でリマスターおよび最適化。
 
 
 あなたの決断がその後の行動や結果を大きく左右する。驚くほど鮮やかで、ディテール満載の大宇宙をその身で体験せよ。  映画のような壮大な物語をもういちど  心躍るアクションと魅力的なストーリーが 1 つに融合。自分の選択がストーリーの展開を決める。
   3 つのゲームを 1 つのランチャーからプレイ : シングルプレイヤーのゲーム本編と、3 タイトルからの 40 本以上もの DLC、プロモ武器、アーマー、パックを遊び尽くそう。
   新世代のリマスター : 4K Ultra HD で三部作を体験しよう。向上したパフォーマンス、ビジュアル、グラフィックのすべてが HDR に対応。
   全三部作のビジュアルを改善 : アップデートには、さらに拡充されたモデルやシェーダー、FX、ライティング、被写界深度が含まれる。また、オーディオの音質も格段に向上。  シェパードの伝説を体験せよ  外見やスキル、専用武器に至るまでのカスタマイズが可能。自分だけのキャラクターを作って、危機に陥った銀河で精鋭の偵察部隊を率いて戦え。
   新たなシェパードのカスタマイズ : 改良された髪型、メイク、目の色、肌のトーンで自分だけのシェパードを作成しよう。キャラクタークリエイトが統合されて三部作すべての選択肢が利用可能に。また、「Mass Effect 3」の象徴である女性シェパードも全タイトルで選択できる。
   Mass Effect 1 作目のゲームプレイを強化 : 改良されたエイムや武器バランス、SFX、操作しやすくなった Mako、分隊の挙動、遮蔽時の挙動、ゲームプレイカメラなど、遊びやすさも大幅に向上。  自らの選択を再考せよ  プレイヤーの選択が三部作全てに反映される。1 つの決断によって、あらゆる任務、あらゆる関係、すべての戦い、さらには銀河の運命もが変わることになる。
   Mass Effect 1 作目のビジュアル強化:ワールドのアートや視覚効果、ステージのライティング再設定など、ゲーム全体におよぶビジュアルの再構築が施されている。
   PC 版アップデート: 3 作すべてで最新 PC の性能を活かした体験を楽しめる。ネイティブコントリーラーサポート、21:9 ワイドスクリーンサポート、ユーザーインターフェースナビゲーションの改善、DirectX 11 互換。   収録内容   「Mass Effect Legendary Edition」には、「Mass Effect」、「Mass Effect 2」、「Mass Effect 3」の 3 タイトルのシングルプレイヤー本編、お気に入りのシングルプレイヤーストーリー DLC、プロモ武器、アーマー、パックを収録。

Kun én person kan forsvare menneskeheden mod den største trussel nogensinde. Genoplev legenden om Commander Shepard i den anmelderroste Mass Effect-trilogi med Mass Effect Legendary Edition. Omfatter grundlæggende singleplayer-indhold og over 40 DLC fra Mass Effect-, Mass Effect 2- og Mass Effect 3-spillene med blandt andet promovåben, panser og pakker – i en ny og forbedret udgave, der er optimeret til 4K Ultra HD.

 Oplev et overdådigt og utroligt detaljeret univers, hvor dine beslutninger har vidtrækkende konsekvenser for handlingen og udfaldet.  

Genoplev den filmiske saga   
Adrenalinpumpende action blandes med gribende interaktiv historiefortælling, hvor du afgør, hvordan din unikke historie udfolder sig. 

   Tre spil, ét startprogram: Spil det grundlæggende singleplayer-indhold og over 40 DLC fra alle tre spil med blandt andet promovåben, panser og pakker.

   Remastered til en ny generation: Oplev trilogien i 4K Ultra HD med forbedret ydeevne, billeder og grafik, alt sammen tilgængeligt i HDR.

   Visuelle forbedringer af alle tre spil: Opdateringerne omfatter forbedrede modeller, shadere, effekter, lyssætning og dybdeskarphed samt lyd i fuld opløsning.  Oplev legenden om Shepard  Opret og tilpas din egen figurs udseende og færdigheder med et personligt arsenal, og før derefter din rekognosceringsgruppe gennem en galakse i oprør.

   Nye tilpasningsmuligheder for Shepard: Med forbedret hår og makeup samt øjen- og hudfarver kan du skabe din egen Shepard i et integreret figurredigeringsprogram, hvor du får alle valgmuligheder fra hele trilogien, eller vælge at spille som den ikoniske FemShep fra Mass Effect 3, som nu er tilgængelig i alle titler.

   Gameplay-forbedringer af det første Mass Effect-spil: Nyd godt af forbedret sigte og våbenbalance, SFX, bedre Mako-styring, input/styring, gruppeadfærd, dækningsadfærd og gameplay-kameraer.  Reflekter over dine valg  Dine valg overføres gnidningsfrit fra det ene spil til det næste. Hver beslutning, du træffer, vil afgøre udfaldet af hver mission, hver relation, hvert slag – og endda selve galaksens skæbne.

   Visuelle forbedringer af det første Mass Effect-spil: Opbygningen af spilverdenen har fået en fuld overhaling af blandt andet miljøgrafik, visuelle effekter og ny lyssætning på banerne.

   Opdateringer til pc: Få en moderniseret oplevelse på pc på tværs af alle tre spil med indbygget controller og understøttelse af widescreen i 21:9-format, forbedringer af navigationen i brugergrænsefladen og understøttelse af DirectX 11.  Inkluderet indhold  Mass Effect Legendary Edition inkluderer grundlæggende singleplayer-indhold for alle tre titler (Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2 og Mass Effect 3), dit foretrukne DLC til singleplayer-historien, promovåben, panser og pakker:

   DLC: Bring Down the Sky, Genesis, Zaeed — The Price of Revenge, Kasumi — Stolen Memory, Lair of the Shadow Broker, Firewalker Pack, Overlord, Normandy Crash Site, Arrival, Genesis 2, From Ashes, Mass Effect 3: Extended Cut, Leviathan, Omega og Citadel.

   Våben og panser: Cerberus Weapons and Armor, Arc Projector, Collector's Weapon and Armor, Terminus Weapon and Armor, M-21 Incisor, Blood Dragon Armor, Inferno Armor, Recon Hood, Sentry Interface, Umbra Visor, N7 Warfare Gear, AT-12 Raider, Chakram Launcher, M-55 Argus, M-90 Indra og Reckoner Knight Armor.

   Pakker: Equalizer Pack, Aegis Pack, Firepower Pack, Groundside Resistance Pack, Recon Operations Pack, Firefight Pack, ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 1, ME2 Alternate Appearance Pack 2, ME3 Alternate Appearance Pack 1 og N7 Collector's Edition Pack.

C'è una sola persona che può salvare l'umanità dalla più grave minaccia mai esistita. Rivivi la leggenda del comandante Shepard nell'acclamata trilogia di Mass Effect con Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition. Include tutti i contenuti di base per giocatore singolo e oltre 40 contenuti scaricabili di Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2 e Mass Effect 3, tra cui armi, corazze e pacchetti promozionali, rimasterizzati e ottimizzati in 4K Ultra HD.
 
 Scopri un universo ricco e dettagliato, in cui le tue decisioni hanno conseguenze profonde sull'azione e sugli esiti.  

Rivivi la saga cinematografica   
L'azione mozzafiato incontra un'avvincente narrazione interattiva, in cui sarai tu a decidere come si svolgerà la tua storia.

   Tre giochi, un unico launcher: Goditi i contenuti di base per giocatore singolo e oltre 40 contenuti scaricabili per tutti e tre i giochi, che includono corazze, pacchetti e armi promozionali.

   Rimasterizzata per la nuova generazione: Scopri la trilogia in 4K Ultra HD con miglioramenti per prestazioni, visuali e grafica, tutti disponibili in HDR.

   Miglioramenti visivi a tutti e tre i giochi: Gli aggiornamenti includono modelli avanzati, shader, effetti, illuminazione e profondità di campo, oltre a un audio di massima risoluzione.  Vivi la leggenda di Shepard  Crea e personalizza il tuo personaggio, a partire dall'aspetto e dalle abilità, fino alla scelta del suo arsenale, poi guida la tua squadra di ricognizione d'élite in una galassia in subbuglio.

   Nuove personalizzazioni di Shepard: Con capelli, trucco, colore degli occhi e tonalità della pelle migliorati, puoi realizzare il tuo Shepard in un creatore di personaggi unificato con tutte le opzioni disponibili nell'intera trilogia, oppure scegliere di giocare nei panni dell'iconica FemShep di Mass Effect 3, ora disponibile in tutti i titoli.

   Miglioramenti all'azione di gioco per il primo Mass Effect: Mira più precisa, bilanciamento delle armi, migliori effetti sonori, comandi Mako, input/comandi, comportamento di squadra, comportamento al riparo e visuale di gioco.  Rifletti sulle tue scelte  Le tue scelte vengono mantenute nel passaggio da un gioco al successivo. Ogni tua decisione può influire su ciascuna missione, relazione o battaglia... e perfino sul destino della galassia.

   Miglioramenti visivi per il primo Mass Effect: Tutto il mondo di gioco è stato rivisitato, dall'arte ambientale, agli effetti visivi, ai livelli.

   Aggiornamenti PC: goditi una moderna esperienza per PC in tutti e tre i giochi, con miglioramenti alla navigazione nell'interfaccia utente, supporto nativo di widescreen 21:9, controller e compatibilità con DirectX 11.   

Contenuti inclusi   

Mass Effect Legendary Edition include i contenuti di base per giocatore singolo di tutti e tre i titoli (Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2 e Mass Effect 3), i contenuti scaricabili della storia per giocatore singolo, armi, corazze e pacchetti promozionali:

   Contenuti scaricabili: Impatto imminente, Genesi, Zaeed — Il prezzo della vendetta, Kasumi — La memoria rubata, La tana dell'Ombra, Pacchetto Firewalker, Overlord, Punto di schianto della Normandy, Avvento, Genesi 2, Dalle ceneri, Mass Effect 3: Extended Cut, Leviatano, Omega e Cittadella.

 ​  Armi e corazze: Arma e corazza di Cerberus, Proiettore ad arco, Arma e corazza dei Collettori, Arma e corazza del Terminus, M-21 Incisor, Corazza di sangue di drago, Corazza Inferno, Passamontagna da ricognizione, Interfaccia Sentinella, Visore Umbra, Arsenale completo N7, AT-12 Raider, Chakram, M-55 Argus, M-90 Indra e Corazza Reckoner Knight.

   Pacchetti: Pacchetto equalizzatore, Pacchetto Aegis, Pacchetto Potenza di fuoco, Pacchetto Groundside Resistance, Pacchetto Ricognizione, Pacchetto Scontro infuocato, ME2 - Pacchetto Aspetti Alternativi 1, ME2 - Pacchetto Aspetti Alternativi 2, ME3 - Pacchetto Aspetti Alternativi 1 e Pacchetto N7 Collector's Edition.

今天，我们 宣布了 《质量效应》传奇版即将推出！我们已听说（很多年了！）为响应您对《质量效应》重置版的需求，经过多方打磨，我们非常高兴地宣布我们将推出《质量效应》三部曲重置版。


数月以来，我们在 BioWare 的开发团队一直在为这三款大作的更新升级而努力，不断打磨其在纹理、着色、模型、特效和技术方面的功能。我们的目标不是将原版游戏改写或重构，而是为了让游戏体验更加现代化，让喜欢《质量效应》的老粉和新晋玩家能够在游玩原汁原味的经典的同时，获得最佳游戏体验。能看到薛帕德指挥官的冒险之旅在超强分辨率、更快帧率及视觉增强的绚丽画面的加持下开启全新征程，真是相当令人兴奋。作为游戏开发人员，我们始终希望我们开发的游戏能够超越它们原本的平台。有机会重置《质量效应》三部曲意味着我们过去十年工作的成果将会继续存续下去，而呈现效果将比以往任何时候都更加丰富清晰。

《质量效应》传奇版 将包含单人基础内容及《质量效应》《质量效应2》及《质量效应3》DLC，更有多种促销武器、装甲，及各种组合包等你来拿——所有内容，全部重置优化新升级，4k Ultra HD，等你体验。2021春季即将登陆 xbox One，PlayStation 4和 PC平台 ，可在Xbox Series X 及 PlayStation 5平台向上兼容，让您获得多种具有针对性的升级换代游玩体验。更多信息将在新的一年推出！

One person is all that stands between humanity and the greatest threat it’s ever faced. Relive the legend of Commander Shepard in the highly acclaimed Mass Effect trilogy with the Mass Effect Legendary Edition. Includes single-player base content and over 40 DLC from Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, and Mass Effect 3 games, including promo weapons, armors and packs — remastered and optimized for 4K Ultra HD.
 
 Experience an amazingly rich and detailed universe where your decisions have profound consequences on the action and the outcome.  

Relive the Cinematic Saga    
Heart-pounding action meets gripping interactive storytelling, where you decide how your unique story unfolds.  

   Three Games, One Launcher: Play through the single-player base content and over 40 DLC from all three games, including promo weapons, armors, and packs.

   Remastered for a New Generation: Experience the trilogy in 4K Ultra HD with enhanced performance, visuals, and graphics, all available in HDR.

   Gameplay Enhancements for the First Mass Effect Game: Enjoy improved aiming and weapons balance, SFX, better Mako controls, input/controls, squad behavior, cover behavior and gameplay cameras.    Reflect on Your Choices   Your choices seamlessly travel from one game to the next. Each decision you make will control the outcome of every mission, every relationship, every battle — and even the fate of the galaxy itself. 

   Visual Enhancements for the First Mass Effect Game: The game's been given a full world-building pass including environmental art, VFX and level relighting.

   PC Updates: Enjoy a modernized PC experience across all three games with native controller and 21:9 widescreen support, user interface navigation improvements, and DirectX 11 compatibility.

Steins;Gate is a Japanese visual novel developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus. It is the second game in the Science Adventure series following Chaos;Head. The game is described by the development team as a "hypothetical science ADV" and explores time and time travel in 2010 Akihabara. The gameplay follows non-linear plot lines which offer branching scenarios with courses of interaction.

The story of Steins;Gate takes place in Akihabara and is about a group of friends who have customized their microwave into a device that can send text messages to the past. As they perform different experiments, an organization named SERN who has been doing their own research on time travel tracks them down and now the characters have to find a way to avoid being captured by them.

————那是我们所得到的偶然产物

冈部伦太郎——通称冈伦——是个尚未从厨二病毕业的大学生。
自称为「狂气的疯狂科学家·鳳凰院凶真」，与其他两名成员组成立了名为「未来道具研究所」的社团，每天和朋友们发明着稀奇古怪的东西。

这样的他在一次偶然间发明了能将电子短信传到过去的道具，
也就是说产生了“时间机器”——

SERN、John Titor、幻之古董PC“IBN5100”、时间机器、
蝴蝶效应、时间旅行的11种理论——在这诸多要素偶然重叠之时，秋叶原卷起了世界规模的大事件！
被委以“未来选择权”的冈伦他们下的决断是？

-Decide The Fate Of All Mankind- 
 CAN YOU CHANGE THE COURSE OF FATE?
 AND SAVE THE ONES CLOSEST TO YOU?
 
 STEINS;GATE is the award-winning time travel science-fiction interactive visual novel developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus.
 It is widely considered to be one of the finest Visual Novels ever made.
 
 STEINS;GATE follows a rag-tag band of tech-savvy young students who discover the means of changing the past via mail, using a modified microwave. Their experiments into how far they can go with their discovery begin to spiral out of control as they become entangled in a conspiracy surrounding SERN, the organisation behind the Large Hadron Collider, and John Titor who claims to be from a dystopian future.
 
 Interaction with the game takes place through the “phone trigger” system, where the player can receive calls and text messages and decide whether to reply to them or not, changing the outcome of the game’s plot.
 
  Features: 
   Non-Linear Visual Novel - Discover multiple different endings depending on your choices in-game.
   HD 1080P - Enjoy the game with HD graphics and illustrations.
   Phone Trigger System - Interact via Rintaro’s cellphone to answer or ignore calls, and send and recieve emails. Your everday choices in life steer the story!
   30-50 hours of reading time

STEINS;GATE es la galardonada novela visual interactiva de ciencia ficción sobre viajes en el tiempo desarrollada por 5pb. y Nitroplus.
 
Se la considera una de las mejores novelas visuales de todos los tiempos.
 

 
STEINS;GATE cuenta la historia de una banda de brillantes estudiantes que descubren los medios tecnológicos para cambiar el pasado a través del correo utilizando un microondas modificado. Sus experimentos sobre lo lejos que pueden llegar con su descubrimiento comienzan a descontrolarse cuando se ven envueltos en una conspiración en la que está implicada la SERN, la organización responsable del Gran Colisionador de Hadrones, y John Titor, quien dice venir de un futuro distópico.

命运石之门（Steins;Gate）的Steins德语的意思是石头，音译：斯坦因）。强调：在故事中，名词创造者本人——冈部伦太郎/凤凰院凶真明确地指出：这个名词是没有任何含义的，与任何人和事件亦或者物件无关，而没有含义才导致了它却是本作最终的关键词。

5pb.Games于2008年推出了由社长志仓千代丸亲自企划并担当制作人的科学幻想作品[Chaos;Head]后，取得了非凡的成功与不俗的成绩。在改编为新番动画后人气更是经久不衰，在2009年年初推出的“增强完整版”性质的[Chaos;Head Noah]在次时代主机Xbox360上首周竟也卖出万套以上。携此作的空前成功之势，5pb.Games在2009年10月15日推出同系列新作[Steins;Gate]，前作的核心团队新加入话题人物组成了更强的制作团队。本作在发售后取得了超高的人气，超高的口碑与超高的销量。可以视为5pb.游戏分公司成立以来最为成功的一款作品。而其制作人志仓千代丸、剧本家林直孝也因此成为了人气飙升的话题人物。

命运石之门

冈部伦太郎–中二病的大学生，自称疯狂科学家-凤凰院凶真。他在“未来机械研究所”里发明了“电话烤箱（暂定）”，这个道具有着是类似时空旅行的惊人机能，能够对过去寄送电子邮件。某日，主角遇到了18岁的天才少女-牧瀬红莉栖，但是，就在数个小时前，主角才亲眼目击到她在大厦的屋顶遭到杀害…故事由此展开。

localized_description.text:
欢迎来到神秘的霍利山庄，有别于一般宅邸，这里的房间会自行变化。《Blue Prince》将神秘因子、策略规划与解谜要素熔于一炉，创新打造出随机性十足的冒险之旅。一路摸索，能否抵达传言中的46号房？

踏入霍利山庄，门后会出现什么房间，都由你来决定。宅邸的探索路径便与这一次次选择息息相关。门扉洞开，新奇房间便显出真容，既有独特挑战，也有待解玄机。不过宅邸的平面图每天都会重置，今天看到的房间可能过了一晚就变了模样，规划时一定要多加注意。

你的每日成果由两部分组成，一是选择规划的房间，二是这些房间内找到的各类工具。以多样创意方式利用游戏道具，进而出谋划策来应对每日挑战，不断推进探索进程。宅邸会在破晓时分完成重置，还请谨慎行事。届时，永久升级以外的一切都会在蓝图上消失得无影无踪。至于能不能找到永久升级项目，就各凭本事了。

作为霍利山庄的继承人，在变幻莫测的厅堂中寻到46号房，这便是你的使命所在。越往宅邸内部推进，你越发现事情并非一个失踪房间那么简单。勒索、政治阴谋，还有当地童书作者的神秘失踪，交织成了亟待调查的大宅往事。步步深入，过去远比你想象得要近。

Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will the unpredictable path you create lead you to the rumored Room 46?

Welcome to Mt. Holly, the mysterious manor with shifting rooms. In  Blue Prince , you embark on a genre-defying experience, filled with a unique mix of mystery, strategy, and puzzles that weave together to create an unpredictable journey. Will your explorative steps lead you to the rumored Room 46?
 
       
 
 Upon reaching a closed door in Mt. Holly, you decide what room appears behind it and each decision shapes your path as you navigate through the manor. Every door can reveal new and exciting chambers that contain their own unique challenges and secrets. But be careful how you draft, for each day the manor’s floor plan resets and the rooms you saw today may not be the same rooms you see tomorrow.
 
       
 
 Your progress each day is shaped by the rooms you select to draft and the tools you find within them. Items in the game can be used in a number of creative ways to fuel your exploration deeper into the house, allowing you to adopt unique strategies to combat the challenges that each day brings. Yet, tread wisely – the house resets each dawn, erasing all but the permanent upgrades to your estate blueprint. That is, if you were clever enough to find one!
 
       
 
 As the heir of Mt. Holly, you have been tasked to explore its shifting halls in search of Room 46. Yet as your journey takes you further into the mansion’s depths, you start to discover that there is more lurking under the surface than a missing room. Investigate a past woven with the threads of blackmail, political intrigue, and the mysterious disappearance of a local children’s book author. The deeper you venture, the more you realize that the past is closer than it appears.

Te damos la bienvenida a Monte Holly, la enigmática mansión con habitaciones cambiantes. En  Blue Prince,  disfrutarás de una experiencia que rompe con los géneros y te brinda una combinación única de misterio, estrategia y puzles para crear un viaje de lo más inesperado. ¿Y quién sabe? Puede que tu afán exploratorio te lleve hasta la críptica habitación 46.
 
    
 Al toparte con una puerta cerrada en Monte Holly, podrás decidir qué habitación aparece tras ella. Cada decisión que tomes irá forjando tu camino a medida que avances por la mansión. Todas las puertas tienen el potencial de revelar una sala fascinante, con sus propios secretos y desafíos. Pero ten cuidado y diseña con cabeza, ya que el plano de la mansión cambia todos los días y las habitaciones que veas hoy no tienen por qué estar mañana.
 
    
 Tu progreso diario dependerá de las habitaciones que diseñes y las herramientas que encuentres en ellas. Los objetos del juego pueden usarse de varias formas; gracias a ellos, podrás dar rienda suelta a tu creatividad, explorar los lugares más recónditos de la mansión y aplicar estrategias para superar los desafíos a los que te enfrentes cada día. Eso no significa que vaya ser un camino de rosas, ya que, al amanecer, la casa cambia por completo y lo perderás todo salvo las mejoras permanentes que le hayas hecho al plano. Si es que has tenido el ingenio suficiente como para encontrarlo, claro.
 
    
 Al heredar Monte Holly, también se te ha encomendado la misión de explorar sus mutables paredes en busca de la habitación 46. Pero, a medida que te adentres en la mansión, irás descubriendo que bajo la superficie hay mucho más que una habitación oculta. Investiga un pasado que se entreteje con extorsiones, tramas políticas y la misteriosa desaparición de una escritora de libros infantiles de la zona. Sigue profundizando y verás que el pasado está más cerca de lo que parecía.

Bienvenue au Mont Holly, l'étrange manoir où les pièces changent de place. Dans  Blue Prince , vivez une expérience inédite riche en mystères, en stratégie et en énigmes qui s'entremêlent pour vous proposer une aventure imprévisible. Votre périple vous mènera-t-il jusqu'à l'objet de toutes les rumeurs : la chambre 46 ?
 
    
 Au Mont Holly, lorsque vous arrivez devant une porte close, c'est à vous de décider quelle pièce apparaîtra de l'autre côté. Chacune de vos décisions influe sur le cours de votre aventure dans le manoir. Chaque porte peut s'ouvrir sur une nouvelle chambre intrigante contenant ses propres secrets et difficultés. Réfléchissez bien à vos choix, car chaque jour, l'agencement du manoir se réinitialise. Les pièces que vous avez visitées aujourd'hui seront donc peut-être différentes le lendemain.
 
    
 Votre progression quotidienne est façonnée par les pièces que vous décidez d'ajouter et par les outils que vous y trouvez. Utilisez les objets du jeu de nombreuses façons différentes et originales, et adoptez des stratégies uniques pour surmonter les épreuves que vous réserve chaque journée, afin de poursuivre votre exploration du manoir. Toutefois, avancez prudemment, car la maison se réinitialise chaque jour, et seules les améliorations permanentes du plan de votre demeure sont conservées. Enfin, encore faut-il arriver à en trouver...
 
    
 Après avoir hérité du Mont Holly, vous décidez d'explorer ses couloirs en mouvement à la recherche de la chambre 46. Au fil de votre aventure dans les entrailles de cette demeure, vous découvrirez peu à peu qu'elle renferme bien des secrets. Plongez-vous dans le passé, où se mêlent des affaires de chantage, des intrigues politiques et la disparition mystérieuse d'un auteur de livres pour enfants. En fin de compte, le passé n'est peut-être pas si lointain que cela.

Willkommen in Mt. Holly, dem geheimnisvollen Anwesen mit seinen sich verändernden Zimmern. In  Blue Prince  begibst du dich auf ein genreübergreifendes Abenteuer mit einer einzigartigen Mischung aus Mystery, Strategie und Rätseln, die dir ein unvorhersehbares Spielerlebnis beschert. Werden dich deine Erkundungen zum berüchtigten Zimmer 46 führen?
 
 
    
 Sobald du in Mt. Holly vor einer geschlossenen Tür stehst, bestimmst du, welches Zimmer dahinter erscheint. Dabei bestimmt jede deiner Entscheidungen deinen Weg durch das Anwesen. Hinter jeder Tür warten neue und spannende Zimmer mit einzigartigen Herausforderungen und Geheimnissen. Doch sei vorsichtig, denn jeden Tag verändert sich der Grundriss des Anwesens und die Zimmer, die du heute gesehen hast, sind morgen vielleicht nicht mehr dieselben.
 
 
    
 Dein täglicher Fortschritt wird von den Zimmern bestimmt, die du auswählst, und von den Dingen, die du darin findest. Gegenstände im Spiel können auf unterschiedliche Weise genutzt werden, um die Erkundung des Hauses voranzutreiben, sodass du einzigartige Strategien anwenden kannst, um die Herausforderungen jedes einzelnen Tages zu meistern. Aber bewege dich vorausschauend – das Haus wird mit jeder Dämmerung zurückgesetzt und alles, mit Ausnahme der permanenten Verbesserungen, verschwindet im Grundriss des Anwesens. Sofern es dir überhaupt gelingt, eine solche Verbesserung zu finden!
 
 
    
 Als Erbe von Mt. Holly hast du die Aufgabe, die sich verändernden Gänge auf der Suche nach Zimmer 46 zu erkunden. Je tiefer du in das Anwesen vordringst, desto bewusster wird dir, dass dort noch weit mehr lauert als nur ein verschollenes Zimmer. Komm einer Vergangenheit auf die Spur, die aus den Fäden von Erpressung, politischen Intrigen und dem geheimnisvollen Verschwinden eines Kinderbuchautors aus der Umgebung gesponnen wurde. Und je mehr du erkundest, desto bewusster wird dir, dass die Vergangenheit näher ist, als es scheint.
